prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body candid fashion portrait of an approved adult woman in an industrial urban setting.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult brunette woman with long hair in a sleek ponytail, natural makeup and subtle freckles. She stands confidently with both hands in trouser pockets, wearing a thick black crocheted jumper with deep navy and teal horizontal stripes, fitted black trousers with lace-up ankle detail, and black strappy heels.
prompt.composition_elements: 2:3 full-body composition against an old brick warehouse wall, red metal door, exposed staircase and railings, and textured concrete ground.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight and gentle shadows, crisp knit and masonry texture, spontaneous modern street-editorial atmosphere.
